description: Sends a TikTok Shop Target Collaboration invite to named creators, or creates an Open Collaboration plan. The first call returns a proposal and a confirmation_ref; nothing is sent. A call with the same arguments and that confirmation_ref sends it once: each creator gets their own target invite with their own collaboration_id so one can be changed or canceled alone, and each creator who receives one goes on the campaign roster with their invite status, with no charge. A creator the brand never messaged on TikTok gets only the handle opt-out check. message carries no creator guidelines; the check catches only their exact text, not a paraphrase. The first call looks up the handles one at a time and checks each one for each product, about one second for each handle and product. Above 25 handles times products, one call can run past 60 seconds, when a host can end it. When the lookup passes 150 seconds, nothing is sent. A long list can run out of time or hit a TikTok rate limit after the yes: the result names who is still pending, and they need a new proposal. Example: campaign_id spring-launch, type target, product_id from the campaign, creator_handles ["ada.glow"]. action cancel withdraws a sent target invite, and action edit changes its commission_rate (product_id picks the product when it has several) or end_time; both take collaboration_id and the same two calls. action edit with remove_creator_handles takes those creators off the invite and the others keep it unchanged, so one creator gets other terms only by leaving it and receiving an invite of their own. action remind schedules one reminder DM to the invited creators who have not answered, with collaboration_ids, days_after and message and the same two calls; action cancel_reminder with reminder_id stops it. action rule_propose (same two calls) turns on a sending rule for this campaign: product_id, commission_rate, message (only {creator_name} may vary), daily_limit, run_from, run_until, time_zone and end_time, each named by the marketer, at most 100 a day, 7 days. The marketer approves on the Storika card in Claude, or by the reply the proposal asks for in marketer_reply. rule_status reads it, rule_cancel stops new sends; any member may run both. rule_send sends under a rule with no approval per send: rule_id and creator_handles only, at most 25; the rule fills note, product and commission. A creator who cannot be sent is named in the reply.

action.description: send (default) a new invite; cancel or edit a sent one; remind or cancel_reminder a reminder DM; rule_propose, rule_status, rule_cancel or rule_send a sending rule.

collaboration_id.description: cancel or edit: the sent invite id.

collaboration_ids.description: remind: 1 to 50 invite ids this campaign sent.

commission_rate.description: Percent 1 to 80 for each product without its own; default: campaign rate.

confirmation_ref.description: Absent: the call returns a proposal and a one-use confirmation_ref and changes nothing. Present: the confirmation_ref that proposal returned; Storika applies it once, and refuses it while the marketer has not pressed Approve on the Storika card shown with the proposal.

daily_limit.description: rule_propose: the marketer's most invites a day.

days_after.description: remind: the marketer's number of days from now.

end_time.description: edit: new end; rule_propose: rule end, at most 7 days away. ISO 8601 time.

marketer_reply.description: rule_propose, if asked: the marketer's exact reply.

message.description: target only: invite note, max 500 characters, sent exactly as given; Storika applies no Learned Facts of BRAND.md or CAMPAIGN.md to it. remind: the reminder DM text.

product_id.description: A product id of the campaign brand's TikTok Shop; or use products.

products.description: target only: several products of the campaign brand's TikTok Shop, each with its own commission.

remove_creator_handles.description: edit: handles to take off the invite.

resolve_conflicts.description: target only: end listed earlier invites first.

rule_id.description: rule_send: the id of the rule to send under.

run_from.description: rule_propose: sending starts, HH:MM in time_zone.

run_until.description: rule_propose: sending stops, HH:MM in time_zone.

time_zone.description: rule_propose: IANA zone of the hours, e.g. Asia/Seoul.

type.description: target: named creators; open: any creator joins.

name: send_tiktok_shop_invite
title: Send TikTok Shop Invite
